                    ### Question
                    A 21-year-old medical student is studying different types of necrosis and tissue injuries. In the pathology laboratory, he observes different dead tissues under the microscope and notices the changes that are occurring as a function of time. After serial observations, he deduced that coagulation necrosis is...?

                    ### Options
                    opa. The result of denaturation of glucose
opb. The result of hydrolytic enzymes
opc. Characterized by the preservation of cellular shape
opd. Characteristic of brain ischemia
ope. Commonly associated with acute pancreatic necrosis

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Coagulation necrosis is characterized by the preservation of cellular shape. It is commonly associated with acute pancreatic necrosis and is not the result of denaturation of glucose or hydrolytic enzymes. While it can be seen in brain ischemia, it is not characteristic of brain ischemia.
